meta.title: Machine Learning
meta.audience: Working engineers and strong CS students who can code but have not formally studied ML. Comfortable with Python and basic linear algebra; not assumed to know calculus of optimisation, probability theory, or any ML framework.
meta.summary: How machines learn patterns from data: the foundational ideas that make learning possible, the classical algorithm families and when each applies, how models are trained and evaluated honestly, and what it takes to run them in production.
boundaries: Deep learning architectures beyond the perceptron and basic backpropagation — owned by the Deep Learning pathway
Large language models, transformers, prompting, and generative AI — owned by the LLMs and Generative AI pathway
Production LLM application engineering, RAG, agents — owned by the AI Engineering pathway
Data pipeline and warehouse construction — owned by the Data Engineering pathway
Mathematical proofs and derivations for their own sake; maths appears only where it changes a practitioner's decision
